brief:
Maha Husseini discussed how Israeli restrictions on everyday items amplify psychological suffering in Gaza, arguing that even seemingly minor denials compound the trauma of displacement and loss. The Electronic Intifada reported that Husseini characterized these restrictions as part of a broader strategy targeting civilians during winter months.

Abubaker Abed welcomed Ireland's decision to grant visas to Gazan students as a rare opening for educational opportunity. He advised the students on navigating life outside Gaza amid the ongoing conflict.
dek: Maha Husseini on the deep emotional impact of Israel restricting even “insignificant” things. Abubaker Abed on Ireland finally granting visas to Gazan students and his advice to them.
title: Winter restrictions deepen Gaza humanitarian crisis, advocates say
